entries.value: "Native literature research for base-studio-code (#1196) — arXiv · Semantic Scholar · PubMed/PMC · Crossref search/retrieval, native PDF extraction, and citation-grounded semantic search. Shipped as the bundled `bsc-research-mcp` stdio MCP server so the planner can ground plans & skills in real sources with no download/build/Docker."

lead: # build.rs parses the committed graph store directly — see crates/graph-materialize/build.rs.
# The core lib (no Tauri, no async runtime) so the bundled MCP binary stays lean and the
# search/parse logic is unit-testable against recorded fixtures with no live network.

lead: # THE SHARED CRATE ROOT — this crate owns no source file at all. See
# crates/graph-materialize/crate_root.rs; the crate's own docs come from its record.
# Shared leaf utilities (#1646): the one epoch clock (`now_secs`).
# Shared CLI scaffold (#1762): the per-command help catalog `bsc research` renders (`CmdDoc`, `handle_help`).
# Shared SQLite plumbing (#1863): the `:memory:`-aware open + default-path + JSON-blob row helpers
# the cache shares with compliance/plandb/skilldb (`conn` feature pulls in rusqlite there).
# Shared stdio JSON-RPC 2.0 core (#1622): the handshake, builders, dispatch, and run-loop. This crate
# supplies its own `tool_schemas` + `call_tool` + arg parsers via the `ToolServer` trait.
# Blocking HTTP for the source clients — keeps the server a simple synchronous stdin loop (no tokio).
# Read-only XML DOM for the Atom (arXiv) + E-utilities (PubMed/PMC) responses — pure Rust, no codegen.
# Local on-disk cache of fetched records + extracted full text (keyed by canonical id), so repeated
# grounding is fast/offline-friendly and respects upstream rate limits. `bundled` matches plandb.
# Native PDF text extraction (no Docker/GROBID) for arXiv/PMC-OA/publisher full text.
